summary: Azure resources use hierarchical verbose IDs that include the resource type, so a jq regex can capture and categorize it, for example lowercasing Microsoft.Compute to compute.
questions: How can I derive the resource type from an Azure resource ID in jq?
How do I categorize Azure resources in resource reporting?

answer_card.title: Azure resource queries
answer_card.answer_md: Azure resource IDs include the type, so use a `jq` regex to capture it dynamically, e.g. extract `Microsoft.Compute` and lowercase it to `"compute"`.
